courses.title: Beginner Workshop: Loss & Grief: Bearing the Unbearable
courses.description: A two-hour Saturday morning workshop with Gen Kelsang Chokyi at the Kadampa Meditation Center Indianapolis, open to beginners. Drawing on Buddha's teaching that loss and change are natural, it explores why loss brings grief and how wisdom and compassion can turn grief into insight and inner peace.
